hook: Zhavoronkov built Insilico Medicine to prove that generative AI could do more than analyze biology, it could design new drug candidates outright, and Rentosertib, discovered and designed by Insilico's AI pipeline, became one of the first such molecules to reach human clinical trials.
name: Alex Zhavoronkov

quote.text: We are not just using AI to analyze biology, we are using it to generate entirely new hypotheses and molecules that no human would have designed.
quote.context: A recurring theme of Zhavoronkov's public talks and interviews on Insilico's generative drug discovery approach

primary.name: Alex Zhavoronkov, official bio, Insilico Medicine
Insilico Medicine, Rentosertib clinical program overview

secondary.name: This AI Drug Was Designed From Scratch. It's Now in Clinical Trials, Wired (2023)

timeline.event: Publishes early work applying GANs to drug discovery
timeline.impact: Generative AI for molecule design demonstrated

timeline.event: Insilico's AI-discovered drug candidate enters clinical trials
timeline.impact: First fully AI-discovered and designed molecule to reach human testing

timeline.event: Rentosertib advances through Phase II trials
timeline.impact: AI-drug-discovery pipeline validated at a later clinical stage

quick_facts: Founder and CEO of Insilico Medicine, an AI-driven drug discovery company
Led development of Rentosertib, among the first AI-discovered and AI-designed drugs to reach human clinical trials
Coined the concept of 'longevity biotechnology' as a distinct research field
Author of The Ageless Generation (2013) and hundreds of peer-reviewed papers

achievements.title: Founding Insilico Medicine (2014)
achievements.impact: Built one of the first companies to apply generative AI directly to drug target discovery and molecule design, not just data analysis.

achievements.title: Rentosertib reaches Phase II clinical trials
achievements.impact: Among the first drug candidates whose target discovery, molecular design, and trial-readiness were all substantially AI-generated, a landmark proof of concept for the field.

achievements.title: Publishing extensively on AI in aging and drug discovery
achievements.impact: His lab's research helped define generative adversarial networks' application to molecular generation, an approach now widely used across the industry.

achievements.title: Advocacy for longevity biotechnology as a research category
achievements.impact: Helped establish aging itself as a legitimate, fundable target for biotech research and AI application.
